newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Servgro cautions after Interleisure sales.
newsitem.headline: Servgro cautions after Interleisure sales.

text.p: Leisure group Servgro International Ltd on Wednesday cautioned its shareholders ahead of the unbundling of Interleisure Ltd, in which it has a 43.9 percent stake.
It's announcement came after media and communications group Primedia Ltd announced on Tuesday that it had bought various Interleisure businesses for 1.5 billion rand.
Servgro said that after the sale of the businesses, Interleisure's assets would be unbundled and voluntarily liquidated.

"Pursuant to the unbundling and liquidation, Interleisure shareholders (including Servgro) will receive Primedia combined units, shares in Sasani Ltd held by Interleisure prior to the disposal and cash," it said.
Interleisure shareholders have been offered cash in lieu of the Primedia combined units at 25.50 rand per unit.
"As a result, Servgro shareholders may receive Primedia combined units and/or cash, rather than Interleisure shares, on implentation or the second phase of Servgro's unbundling."
The company's board of directors was of the view that the disposal and subsequent distribution to Servgro shareholders was a favourable realisation of Servgro's interest in Interleisure.
It advised shareholders to exercise caution in their sharedealings until further detailed implications of the disposal of their Servgro shareholdings was announced in due course.
